spec.title: Create an output file through the fixture GUI
prerequisites: The bundled Python runtime can run tkinter.

steps.expected: A window titled Desktop Agent Fixture is visible.

steps.action: Enter the literal message into the Message field.
steps.expected: The intended input has been delivered to the focused editing surface; correctness is later verified through the produced file.
The application creates a fresh output file containing the entered message.

environment_assumptions: The test owns only the launched fixture window.
The relative entry click is grounded in the observed fixture window rectangle and allowed by this example policy.
The file assertion reads the application-created output; it does not create the output.

operations.intent: Remove any previous fixture output before GUI execution so stale files cannot satisfy this run.
Observe the launched fixture window before interacting.
Focus the Message entry by clicking inside the observed fixture window.
Activate the Create Output button using an observed-window-relative click because Tk does not expose the caption through this Win32 backend.
Wait for the application-created output file.
Verify the produced file contains the literal input.

cleanup.intent: Close only windows observed as owned by this run.
Remove the temporary fixture output so the next run cannot pass on stale state.
